description: This file defines the Returns model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling CRUD operations related to product returns, including adding returns, retrieving return details, histories, and counts.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling product return data within the Opencart platform, including adding returns and retrieving return information and histories.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return by its ID.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records for the current customer, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total number of return records for the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific return.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries for a specific return.
